|birth = {{ne|914}}}}'''Vayella Kamsa''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Red Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Vayelle Kamsa}}

==Abilities==
Vayella is [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|very weak]] in the [[One Power]], with a strength level of {{opsl|40}}. This is marginally above [[Siuan Sanche]]'s strength after she was healed from [[Stilling|Severing]].

== History ==
Vayelle is 86 years old and has been Aes Sedai for 44. She was born in [[914 NE]] and went to the [[White Tower]] in {{ne|932}}. After spending thirteen years as a [[novice]] and eleven years as [[Accepted]], she was raised to the shawl in [[956 NE]].

==Activities==
She was part of the White Tower secret expedition who were to kidnap [[Rand al'Thor]] in [[Cairhien]].

She was captured by the [[Asha'man]] at the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]].{{ref/book|6|55}}

[[Chisaine Nurbaya]], [[Janine Pavlara]], [[Innina Darenhold]] and Vayelle Kamsa are the last four of the prisoners to swear fealty to Rand{{ref/book|9|13}}. They did so under [[Verin]]'s [[Compulsion]].

As with many Aes Sedai sworn to Rand, Vayelle probably fought the [[Last Battle]] on the slopes of [[Thakan'dar]].{{ref/book|14|34}} It is not stated whether she survived or not.
